candidates.description: This feature vector represents Thai conjunctions, prepositions, and common linguistic particles.
These tokens represent various consonants and characters of the Thai script used in writing and typography.
These tokens represent the Thai consonant 'ก' (ko kai), often appearing with various vowel marks, tone markers, and preceding consonants.
These tokens represent Thai script vowel markers, tone marks, and characters.
This feature vector activates on subword tokens and fragments from Thai script and non-standard romanized text.
This feature vector represents common Thai character combinations, syllables, and tonal marks occurring within Thai words.
This vector is related to the animal camel, specifically highlighting its name fragments and multilingual representations.
This feature vector is related to subword tokens, foreign characters, and phonetic fragments associated with the Thai script and phonetic approximations.
This vector represents a multilingual mixture of disconnected subword fragments and noise with no cohesive semantic theme.
This feature vector activates on subwords, characters, and fragments from various non-English languages and scripts.
